messages:
oliver: Heads-up: kicking off a proposal for an automated migration preflight + credit-escrow flow to reduce friction for customers moving off pinned models. Goal: fewer manual credits, faster rollbacks, clearer audit trail. Draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/migration-escrow (WIP)
neha: love it. can we have escrow that only releases after 14 days stable at 100%? also need partial releases if quality improves midway.
tessa: CS note: customers want a single predictable line on the invoice. escrow is fine if we map releases to invoice line-items when released.
raj: infra POV: we need a migration-job service to orchestrate canaries, checks, and ledger ops. propose: POST /migration/start -> {migration_id, webhook_url, status} and a /migration/:id/actions endpoint.
billing-bot: recommend these required fields for any credit action: contract_id, approval_code, ledger_event_id, reason. ledger_event_id is mandatory for accounting reconciliation.
legal-bot: we'll need a standard amendment template + a residency clause for region-locked accounts. also define "credit" vs "service concession" language.
oliver: proposed preflight checks: tokenizer mapping diff, special token compatibility, quantization-path validation, and smoke-run inference on a canned sample. failing preflight -> block escrow creation and notify CS.
neha: eval strategy: always run the canonical probe bundle as the baseline. optionally run a private, sanitized diff against customer prompts if customer opts in. opt-in only to avoid privacy issues.
tessa: credit tier proposal (initial): micro: $1,000; standard: $7,500; enterprise: $30,000. escrow vesting: 50% at day 7, 50% at day 21. clawback if account downgrades within 30 days.
raj: cost-sharing: if customer requests a custom heavy canary that pushes GPU spend above a defined threshold, mark the migration with surcharge=true and surface cost-estimate to CS for approval before run.
neha: gating thresholds draft: gold gate = quality delta >= -0.1% on canonical eval AND p95 latency <= baseline + 20ms. silver gate = quality delta >= -0.25% and p95 <= baseline + 50ms (requires CS approval).
tessa: partial-fail policy idea: infra OK but quality slips between -0.1% and -0.5% -> auto-quarantine, release 25% of escrow, give 14-day remediation window. full failure -> rollback + full credit according to tier.
billing-bot: planned endpoint: POST /credits/apply with payload like: {"migration_id":"<id>","type":"partial","amount_cents":750000,"ledger_ref":"LU-2026-...","contract_id":"C-1234"} -> returns {"event_id":"EV-...","posted_at":"..."}. need idempotency_key.
oliver: runbook sketch:
```
- PRE: run preflight checks; PASS -> create escrow record with tier and ledger_ref
- STEP1: canary 1% for 24h -> run evals -> check gates
- STEP2: ramp 10% for 48h -> run evals -> check gates
- STEP3: ramp 50% for 72h -> run evals -> check gates
- STEP4: final 100% -> monitor 7d -> if stable -> release escrow -> issue invoice credit line or token redeem
- ON_FAIL: rollback to previous model, compute credit per failure-mode, call /credits/apply with ledger_ref
```
raj: add auto-tagging in traces/metrics with migration_id and escrow_tier to help SRE and cost reports. also emit migration lifecycle events to kafka for downstream consumers.
neha: next actions: tessa will draft the amendment + sample invoice line; raj prototypes migration-job API and example webhook payload; billing-bot to stub /credits/apply contract & idempotency; legal-bot to review amendment and residency clauses. i'll schedule a 30m sync Tue.
tessa: ack. i'll also assemble a CSV of migration-ready tenants with residency flags and rough monthly spend to map tiers.
oliver: thanks team. update the doc, not the thread. :white_check_mark:
